# Liquid now at row 50, rising!
# Row 56: cols 31, 32, 33, 34, 36, 38, 40, 42, 44, 45, 46
# Liquid reaching col 31 (leftmost yellow dot)
# Sky blue: 19, Blue: 71

# Continue pouring to fill the container
# Let me use ACTION7 to pour more liquid
for i in range(5):
    result = action(['ACTION7'])
    print(f"Action {i+1}: level_completed={result.get('level_completed')}, done={result.get('done')}")
    
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sky_blue = [(i, j) for i, line in enumerate(lines) for j, ch in enumerate(line) if ch == 'S']
    blue_pixels = sum(1 for i, line in enumerate(lines) for j, ch in enumerate(line) if ch == 'b')
    yellow = [(i, j) for i, line in enumerate(lines) for j, ch in enumerate(line) if ch == 'Y']
    
    # Check sky blue at bottom (rows 50-57)
    bottom_sky = [(r, c) for r, c in sky_blue if r >= 50]
    
    # Check liquid rows
    if bottom_sky:
        liquid_rows = sorted(set(r for r, c in bottom_sky))
        print(f"  Blue: {blue_pixels}, Sky blue: {len(sky_blue)}, Liquid rows: {liquid_rows}")
        for row in liquid_rows:
            row_liquid = sorted(c for r, c in bottom_sky if r == row)
            print(f"    Row {row}: cols {row_liquid}")
        
        # Check which yellow dot columns are covered
        yellow_cols = set(c for r, c in yellow)
        bottom_sky_cols = set(c for r, c in bottom_sky)
        covered = sorted(yellow_cols & bottom_sky_cols)
        uncovered = sorted(yellow_cols - bottom_sky_cols)
        print(f"  Covered: {covered}, Uncovered: {uncovered}")
    
    if result.get('level_completed') or result.get('done'):
        print("Level completed or game done!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
